## Change

Describe the schedule, content, or site change.

## Checklist

- [ ] Talk filenames/permanent URLs were not renamed.
- [ ] Dates and times were checked in `America/New_York`.
- [ ] Speaker, affiliation, title, abstract state, location, and links were verified.
- [ ] New photos are permitted for publication and stored locally.
- [ ] Draft records remain marked `draft: true`; launch-ready records do not.
- [ ] `pnpm test` and `pnpm build` pass locally, or CI will run them.
